title: Functorial K-injective resolutions with injective terms
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] and $\mathsf{Cpx}(\mathcal A)$ its category of cochain complexes and morphisms of complexes (defined as in [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(\mathcal O)$). There are a functor $I:\mathsf{Cpx}(\mathcal A)\to\mathsf{Cpx}(\mathcal A)$ and a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\Rightarrow I$ such that for every complex $K$: $\eta_K:K\to I(K)$ is a quasi-isomorphism, i.e. induces isomorphisms $H^n(K)\to H^n(I(K))$ of cohomology objects for all $n$ (as in [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(\mathcal O)$); $I(K)$ is K-injective, i.e. every morphism of complexes from an acyclic complex to $I(K)$ is homotopic to zero (as in [def-pur-kinjective-complex] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(\mathcal O)$); and every term $I(K)^n$ is an injective object of $\mathcal A$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions].
